title: Add event subscriber for OpenPermissionSetPage
summary: A new event subscriber codeunit enables programmatic opening of the permission set details card based on client signals.
key_points: Adds the codeunit Permission Set Card Subscriber to the System Application
The subscriber opens the permission set details card for the values it is given, so signals from the client can open it
Adds the new codeunit to the Permission Sets - Objects permission set
quote: Add event subscriber that will open permission set details card page for provided values.
